intuition.title: Printed-array stability interpretation
intuition.summary: The authors report that the printed chloride array remains brightly emissive for longer than 24 h in air and suggest slow oxidation may occur without additional device packaging or NC surface treatment. This is the reported printed-film context; it does not identify the original NC synthesis batch.
intuition.scope: Author interpretation or model, as qualified in the linked main-only review; not a direct measurement or batch-specific claim.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
